summary: The reflected minimum profile is correctly shown to be symmetric and log-concave, the lattice doubling and layer-cake argument yields the stated three-quarter core mass, and the separation argument validly converts its halfspace depth into the required lower bound on the accepted integral hitting mass. The repeated-cut theorem applies with all of its hypotheses satisfied, the exact constant estimates give k at most 15n and hence M(q)/(80n), and the lattice-symmetry corollary correctly establishes w_q>0, M(q)=W, and the final comparison. Boundary mass, vertical halfspaces, zero reflected weights, lower-dimensional level sets, and quantifier order are all handled without a gap.
